comparison.objective: One-handedly lock a used needle’s hinged sheath against the table and dispose of the syringe in a sharps tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware barrel grasping, table-reacted hinge rotation and snap-latch closure, followed by disposal; not bimanual screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Sheath catch locked over the needle, unsafe proximity/contact permanently avoided, syringe released in tray and stable for 1 s. Candidate requires selective recovery/retention and 3 s supported dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is one-handed safety-latch actuation under strict needle-clearance constraints, unrelated to sieve-based many-body separation.
